query_behavior: VALUE: supported query, queryReason=null; UNSUPPORTED_POINT: nonempty queryReason, null semantic fields, preserves requested point/subject; does not change run status
batch_behavior: STABLE with observation COMPLETE returns exactly one observation per unique requested (point, subject), including unsupported queries; incomplete observation phase returns an empty atomic batch with explicit INCOMPLETE pipeline

completion.consumer_behavior: Resolve full AnalysisKeys and batch IDs against independent plan; only unavailable dependencies block; structural consumer can request zero analyses/batches.
completion.prepared_behavior: Contains results, explicit dependencies and consumer outcomes; preparation COMPLETE says nothing about delivery.
completion.delivery_behavior: External receipt binds prepared resultId, destination and exact payload SHA-256 when available to independently observed delivery status. COMPLETE requires hash; failure before hashing uses null. Never inside prepared result.
completion.phase_failure: Controlled phase failure never rewrites STABLE analysis; resource exhaustion produces no semantic result.

non_stable_behavior: non-STABLE run publishes no provisional observations; query refusal alone does not make a stable run non-STABLE
version_decision: 1.1.0 adds candidateSupports, analysisReason, full source inventory/per-observation remainders, Entry/Outcome points, operand owner IDs, analyses and generic W4 consumer facts without losing 1.0 intent.

encoding.arrays: explicit full-ID/key/query/candidate/producer order; consumer facts sorted by sequence, batch, point, subject
encoding.numbers: base-10 signed integral counters; unavailable null
encoding.escaping: JSON quotes/backslash/controls; valid Unicode unchanged; unpaired surrogate rejected
encoding.buffering: incremental UTF-8 BufferedWriter, no whole-output byte array requirement
encoding.delivery: external only; temp in destination directory, atomic replace, no fallback, complete after successful close and move

preflight_failure: RESOURCE_LIMIT -> EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_LIMIT; no prepared/semantic result or delivery receipt; outside wire 1.1.0
